carries card item 6 of #27123; #27123 keeps card item 4 and owed item 5 (i18n-extract); the lint example swap is its own card.

## What is owed

#27123 (ADR-0025 M1, local T0 install loop) names its acceptance e2e on the cloud sample `plugins/connector-stripe` (objectstack-ai/cloud): build it, sign it with a test key, `os plugin trust add` the key, `os plugin install` it, boot `os serve`, exercise one tool, `os plugin disable` it, and run the tamper cases (a changed kept artifact, a changed unpacked file, a revoked key) each refusing at load.

Slices 1–2 landed in this repo (#27335, #27374): install, trust store, installation record, boot-time loader with re-verification and tier dispatch, disable / enable / uninstall.

## Why a separate card

The sample lives in objectstack-ai/cloud, so the cloud lane rule applies (SKILL.md `domain:cloud`: any card that reads or changes cloud code belongs to the cloud seat; no cloud-side change is made from this repo). Filed without `domain:*` for triage to route.
